Submit the following for FAA review:

1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the Allergist, Gastroenterologist, or treating physician no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include:

  • A detailed summary of the history of the condition;
  • Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any);
  • Exam findings;
  • Results of any testing performed;
  • Diagnosis;
  • Assessment and plan;
  • Prognosis; and Follow-up.

2. It must specifically include the severity and frequency of the reaction(s) or symptoms as well as the likelihood of them reoccurring.

3. Lab. Results of alpha-gal IgE level or any testing clinically indicated.
